title: JavaScript foundations
description: Wickhollow Candles is a two-person shop that pours candles by hand, and you just became its developer without ever having written a line of code. You start on your first day by making the shop laptop print, count, price and decide, then turn a pile of orders into answers and build helpers that remember. Each issue teaches one part of the language, from your first line to array methods and closures, in one file you run yourself.
